race.comment: WEE BIT KINKY (10) was not a cheap yearling, and her debut run as a juvenile was encouraging. She is resuming as a far easier level, and has won the latest of her 2 public jump-outs. A reasonable draw is in her favour, and she should go very close to winning this, especially if the money comes for her. SECRET CROSSING (8) had an excuse when found to be mildly lame after her last start at Warrnambool over 1400m. Dropping back to 1200m will help her, and she is worth another chance. MISS HOME BODY (7) battled away gamely on debut at Pakenham-synthetic just over 2 weeks ago, and would have learned a lot from that experience. She will find this easier, and is worth each-way consideration. COURT JESTER (3) will be at his peak third up off the back of a couple of sound efforts for fourth to open his career. A good draw should have him right in the finish here.
